name: Cactal
tagline: Build, publish and update websites from Cline: pages, CMS content, forms and domains.
description: Cactal is a website platform for people and AI agents. Connect it and Cline can create a website, write its pages, publish it on a free Cactal address and keep it up to date: CMS content, forms and their submissions, images and custom domains. Every edit keeps a version that can be restored, and tools that publish, change the live site or delete are marked destructive. Sign in with OAuth 2.1 when Cline asks; no API key to paste. A Cactal account is free; a site on your own domain needs Pro ($25 a month). Docs: https://cactal.ai/docs/agents/mcp
